items.name: avatar-group
items.title: Avatar Group
items.description: Avatars with initials fallback and status dots, stacked into a group with a +N bubble that fans out on hover and focus. No JavaScript.

items.name: color-picker
items.title: Color Picker
items.description: OKLCH color picker with a lightness × chroma area, hue and opacity sliders drawn with oklch gradients, sRGB/P3 gamut hints and server-safe conversion helpers.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: Autocomplete input with a filtered listbox in a manual popover placed by CSS anchor positioning, with single, multiple (chips) and custom-value modes.

items.name: context-menu
items.title: Context Menu
items.description: Right-click, long-press and Shift+F10 menu on the Popover API, placed at the pointer with anchor positioning, with checkbox, radio and submenu items.

items.name: data-table
items.title: Data Table
items.description: Server-rendered table with sorting, search, pagination, sticky header and first column, and checkbox selection highlighted by :has(:checked).

items.name: masonry-grid
items.title: Masonry Grid
items.description: Pinterest-style layout on CSS Grid Lanes with a multi-column fallback, no JavaScript.

items.name: pricing-table
items.title: Pricing Table
items.description: Plan cards with a monthly/yearly switch on radio inputs and :has(), no JavaScript, rows aligned across cards with subgrid.

items.name: prompt-input
items.title: Prompt Input
items.description: Chat prompt composer with an auto-growing textarea, file attachments, a toolbar slot and a send button that turns into stop while streaming.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: Native select rendered on the server, with a fully styled picker (icons, descriptions, check mark) through appearance: base-select and an Input-styled native select elsewhere.

items.name: tag-input
items.title: Tag Input
items.description: Text input that turns typed or pasted text into removable tags, with validation, suggestions and form support.
